notes: With cleanup on, you see your words as you speak, and the cleaned text takes their place when you stop or press Enter
Works with the text model of VinPUT Plus and Pro and with a text model on this PC
Settings is laid out the way Windows 11 lays out its own, with each setting on a tile of its own
A new Shortcuts page has every key and what belongs to it, your actions among them
Your settings carry over as they are
Cleanup tidies a dictation before it is typed: as said, clean, a coding prompt or an email, chosen for each key on the new Cleanup page
Edit by voice: select text, hold the edit key and say what to change, and the result takes the place of the selection
Cleanup and editing use VinPUT Plus or Pro, or a text model on this PC, and do not count against your monthly hours
Your own actions: a key that runs a program or script you choose with what you said, under Settings, General, Your actions
Settings is easier to read: sections open and close, long lists scroll on their own, and languages are picked from a list you can search
Voice memos are recorded at the full quality of your microphone
The tray menu and About lead to PUTLAB, where Voutput and other programs are installed
Other programs on this PC can show what you dictate as it is typed, if you let them
Settings, Advanced, Send typed text to connected programs switches it on; it starts switched off
While it is off, nothing you dictate into a window is sent to any program
For developers: the local API has a transcript event with the text so far, the mode and a session number, and a final one when the dictation ends
Settings has a new page, Words: a dictionary for your names and terms, and snippets that stand for a saved text
Say new line, new paragraph, all caps, snake case, camel case or kebab case and it is done; this starts switched on, and Words has the switch
Enter ends a dictation, and is pressed once after your last words
When VinPUT Pro cannot be reached, a model on this PC carries on and no word is lost
Updates are signed: VinPUT installs only an update that comes from its makers
With VinPUT Pro, words are typed as you say them, about half a second after each
When the last words change as you go on, they are corrected in place
Text flows in steadily instead of arriving in bursts
Settings, General, Type words as you say them switches this off
Signing in to VinPUT Pro needs no code: sign in with Google and the browser brings it back
Settings comes to the front by itself once you are signed in
The sign-in pages in the browser look like the VinPUT website
Models says how each model on this PC would run on it: well, slowly, or too heavy
It goes by your graphics card, memory and processor, and follows the graphics card switch
Where no model on this PC runs well, Models says that VinPUT Pro runs online
The listening indicator shows under the caret again after VinPUT has been running for a while
It stays above the window you dictate into, also when you switch windows while dictating
Two new models that run on this PC: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B and 0.6B, in 30 languages (not Slovenian)
A dictation left running stops by itself after 30 minutes of silence, never while a key is held
Settings, General, Stop after silence sets that time
Models says when a model does not know one of your languages
When VinPUT Pro carries on with a model on this PC, it picks only one that knows your languages
Pressing the dictation key with nothing set up to recognize speech opens Settings at the right page
No start click is played when a press cannot dictate
After a new install, that press opens the welcome
A soft click when listening starts and another when it stops, each with its own switch in Settings
A new subscriber pays €3.49 for the first month of Pro or €1.49 for Plus on a monthly plan
While subscribing is not open yet, the plans say Opening soon instead of failing
The Try it field in the welcome no longer shows a grey rectangle
VinPUT Plus, a second subscription: 8 hours a month for €2.50 a month or €24 a year
VinPUT Pro is now 25 hours a month for €5 a month or €49 a year
When a month's hours run out, dictation carries on with a model on this PC
VinPUT Pro has its own place at the top of Models
A welcome after a new install helps you choose between VinPUT Pro and a model on this PC
VinPUT Pro, a subscription: text appears while you speak, in more than 60 languages, also mixed in one sentence, with nothing to download
40 hours a month for €6 a month or €59 a year; sign in with Google from Settings
Manage the subscription in the app or on the account page of the website
A guided setup for your own Google service under Settings, Models, in place of the fields on Advanced
Clearer messages when a key or a service is refused; Remove everything on uninstall also signs out
Escape cancels a dictation: nothing is typed, also while it is still being recognized
Voice memos are saved at a normal listening volume, however softly the microphone records
Voice memos play in every player
Silent install for package managers shows no window and finishes at once
Local models no longer type "Thank you." or other made-up words after you stop speaking
Sound names such as *phone rings*, [Music] or (applause) are never typed
A key pressed by mistake in a quiet room types nothing
Text appears sooner when you pause before letting go of the key
After an update VinPUT reopens and shows the new version
Local models: text appears at each pause while you speak
Local models answer about a third of a second sooner
The first words are no longer lost while a model loads
The idle engine sleeps: nothing runs between dictations
The indicator appears the moment you press the key
A new Settings window in the style of Windows 11, light or dark
Settings take effect as you change them; no Save button
Half the download, and lighter in the background
A new listening indicator, and a tidier tray menu
Dictation keeps working while Settings is open
The tray menu lists the models you added yourself too
Custom models: add a Whisper model from Hugging Face or a file
Audio input: choose the microphone in Settings or the tray
Tray menu: model, microphone and graphics card at a click
The tray icon answers clicks however Vinput was started
Local API: error codes, answers to the sender, limits
Dictate and search: a key that opens your words as a search
The graphics card is used by default when the PC has one
Switching it on or off keeps your downloaded models
A model you choose is in use at once, and Settings shows it
The tray icon stays alive after Vinput was ended by force
Local models run on any graphics card: NVIDIA, AMD or Intel
The graphics card engine is an 18 MB download, not 670 MB
Settings names the graphics card and where the model runs
Models page: what is in use, downloaded or available
Download, Use and Remove buttons, with progress and disk use
No model is preselected; the first start opens the list
Clicking a notification opens the right Settings page
Check for updates button in Settings; Browse for the memo folder
Listed as VinPUT under Installed apps, with its icon
Uninstall also removes companion programs and their startup entries
Silent uninstall for package managers
Local models keep to the languages you set
Documentation and release notes are on the site
Voice memos: record, save as MP3, paste anywhere
Speech models that run on your own PC
Gemini live transcription
Settings with General and Advanced pages
Installs and updates itself; no administrator rights
